Package io.micronaut.starter.feature.json

Interface SerializationFeature

All Superinterfaces:
io.micronaut.core.naming.Described, Feature, JsonFeature, io.micronaut.core.naming.Named, io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
public interface SerializationFeature extends JsonFeature
Represents a serialization feature that extends JSON support in Micronaut. Provides default dependencies and configuration for Micronaut serialization modules.
